title: A great fisher of souls!
html_source:
Likely referencing Matthew 4:19,

He said to them, “Come after me,
and I will make you fishers for men.”

anchor.prefix: power to obtain whatever we pray for if it be for the good of our souls; power above all to obtain for us the grace to repent if we be in sin. A great saint, saint Francis Xavier!
anchor.suffix:
He ceased to shake his clasped hands and, resting them against his forehead, looked right and left of them keenly at his listeners out of his dark stern eyes.
